ana: Heads-up: customer Helix wants a small observability slate for Dedicated 3: per-route cost estimates + lightweight trace hook + quick error alerts. Need a demo next week.

mike: Quick Q - do we include model-level breakdown or just route-level?

ana: Start route-level only. Fields: route id, model, est $/hr, est $/100k tokens. No infra amortization in alpha.

sophia: UX: inline cost on route table, a tiny traces icon opens "recent spans" with metadata; full span fetch on demand. Keep it one-click.

jeff: Ops: full-span retention is heavy. Suggest metadata-only sampling + fetch-on-demand. At 1% for Helix ~18GB/week. Need opt-in per-customer and encryption checks for Private.

mike: Backend plan: hourly cost rolls with route tags; sampling flag + metadata pipeline; API returns cost rows + span-list. I'll draft API by Mon.

sophia: Acceptance criteria: filterable cost table, per-customer sampling toggle, recent spans modal + "fetch full" action, alert template linking to traces, RBAC + audit on views.

ana: Canary: 10% traffic for 24h, success if trace-ingest backlog <45m and cost delta vs billing <5% over 1h. Rollback to aggregated-only if fail. Sales needs summary by EOD.

jeff: I'll add storage and encryption numbers to the ticket.

ops-bot: Created ticket RED-6021: "Helix: per-route econ + trace hook (alpha)" - https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-6021

mike: Starting draft PR for cost agg today.

ana: Thanks, please ping if blockers show up.
